text.card: A red giant 1,450 parsecs away, 22 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.46 solar masses and 22.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,251 K at its surface.
